units.displayText: Nngh!

units.displayText: Undine turns around, pulls out her broken staff, and comes face to face with the wrecker.

spans.text: Undine turns around, pulls out her broken staff, and comes face to face with the wrecker.

(Danger!)

Beeeeeeeeep—
(Danger!)

Beeeeeeeeep—
(Danger!)

units.rawText: Fragments upon fragments spray forth, and the staff in Undine's hands is swallowed up to its middle by the wrecker.
units.displayText: Fragments upon fragments spray forth, and the staff in Undine's hands is swallowed up to its middle by the wrecker.

spans.text: Fragments upon fragments spray forth, and the staff in Undine's hands is swallowed up to its middle by the wrecker.

units.rawText: C-close one!
units.displayText: C-close one!

spans.text: C-close one!

units.rawText: With danger at hand, Undine computes the only possible way to stop the beast in front of her with what processing power she has left—jamming her staff into the machine's engine notches, its one possible weakness, and temporarily stopping its destructive momentum.
units.displayText: With danger at hand, Undine computes the only possible way to stop the beast in front of her with what processing power she has left—jamming her staff into the machine's engine notches, its one possible weakness, and temporarily stopping its destructive momentum.

spans.text: With danger at hand, Undine computes the only possible way to stop the beast in front of her with what processing power she has left—jamming her staff into the machine's engine notches, its one possible weakness, and temporarily stopping its destructive momentum.

units.rawText: Thankfully, she has made a good gamble, and the engine does indeed appear to be a weak spot. The wrecker falls into a brief silence.
units.displayText: Thankfully, she has made a good gamble, and the engine does indeed appear to be a weak spot. The wrecker falls into a brief silence.

spans.text: Thankfully, she has made a good gamble, and the engine does indeed appear to be a weak spot. The wrecker falls into a brief silence.

units.rawText: What are you standing around for, get up there! This... this is an order!
units.displayText: What are you standing around for, get up there! This... this is an order!

spans.text: What are you standing around for, get up there! This... this is an order!

units.rawText: After a brief pause, the wrecker comes to life once more, roaring and shaking as it attempts to starts its engine.
units.displayText: After a brief pause, the wrecker comes to life once more, roaring and shaking as it attempts to starts its engine.

spans.text: After a brief pause, the wrecker comes to life once more, roaring and shaking as it attempts to starts its engine.

units.rawText: No! no!
units.displayText: No! no!

spans.text: No! no!

units.rawText: BANG!
units.displayText: BANG!

spans.text: BANG!

units.rawText: Gah... All's well that ends well, this thing will get some quiet time to itself.
units.displayText: Gah... All's well that ends well, this thing will get some quiet time to itself.

spans.text: Gah... All's well that ends well, this thing will get some quiet time to itself.

units.rawText: She has paid a great price to protect them; both her legs partially engulfed inside the machine's opening. However, Undine knows she had no choice, and has no more to offer.
units.displayText: She has paid a great price to protect them; both her legs partially engulfed inside the machine's opening. However, Undine knows she had no choice, and has no more to offer.

spans.text: She has paid a great price to protect them; both her legs partially engulfed inside the machine's opening. However, Undine knows she had no choice, and has no more to offer.

units.rawText:
Beeeeeeeeep—
(Main unit, emergency, emergency!)
units.displayText:
Beeeeeeeeep—
(Main unit, emergency, emergency!)

spans.text:
Beeeeeeeeep—
(Main unit, emergency, emergency!)

units.rawText: It's only two legs—
units.displayText: It's only two legs—

spans.text: It's only two legs—

units.rawText: Don't worry, I can... ugh!
units.displayText: Don't worry, I can... ugh!

spans.text: Don't worry, I can... ugh!

units.rawText: Undine twists and shifts, trying to free herself from the temporarily motionless maw, but the unsteady front end of the machine brings her tumbling down with it, plummeting to the ground.
units.displayText: Undine twists and shifts, trying to free herself from the temporarily motionless maw, but the unsteady front end of the machine brings her tumbling down with it, plummeting to the ground.

spans.text: Undine twists and shifts, trying to free herself from the temporarily motionless maw, but the unsteady front end of the machine brings her tumbling down with it, plummeting to the ground.

units.rawText: An internal electrical current, or perhaps something else, elicits a mind-shaking pain surging upwards from her tattered legs, disrupting Undine's neural cloud.
units.displayText: An internal electrical current, or perhaps something else, elicits a mind-shaking pain surging upwards from her tattered legs, disrupting Undine's neural cloud.

spans.text: An internal electrical current, or perhaps something else, elicits a mind-shaking pain surging upwards from her tattered legs, disrupting Undine's neural cloud.

units.rawText: A sensation that brings with it both familiarity and terror.
units.displayText: A sensation that brings with it both familiarity and terror.

spans.text: A sensation that brings with it both familiarity and terror.

units.rawText: Neural overload, huh... I see, so there's special anti-Doll measures here...
units.displayText: Neural overload, huh... I see, so there's special anti-Doll measures here...

spans.text: Neural overload, huh... I see, so there's special anti-Doll measures here...

units.rawText: (To affect active Dolls with a neural overload, crashing them, and then decommissioning them... No wonder it's a recycling yard for Dolls.)
units.displayText: To affect active Dolls with a neural overload, crashing them, and then decommissioning them... No wonder it's a recycling yard for Dolls.

spans.text: To affect active Dolls with a neural overload, crashing them, and then decommissioning them... No wonder it's a recycling yard for Dolls.

units.rawText: Undine's torment and helplessness only continues for a brief moment, and is soon replaced in its entirety by a rational despair—under these circumstances, her mind, which she had always held such pride in, would soon fade. All is lost.
units.displayText: Undine's torment and helplessness only continues for a brief moment, and is soon replaced in its entirety by a rational despair—under these circumstances, her mind, which she had always held such pride in, would soon fade. All is lost.

spans.text: Undine's torment and helplessness only continues for a brief moment, and is soon replaced in its entirety by a rational despair—under these circumstances, her mind, which she had always held such pride in, would soon fade. All is lost.

units.rawText:
Beeeeeeeeep—
(Danger, danger! Rescue, prepare!)
units.displayText:
Beeeeeeeeep—
(Danger, danger! Rescue, prepare!)

spans.text:
Beeeeeeeeep—
(Danger, danger! Rescue, prepare!)

units.rawText: No, stay away!
units.displayText: No, stay away!

spans.text: No, stay away!

units.rawText: I can't hold on for much longer. You guys run away; go look for De Lacey! This is an order!
units.displayText: I can't hold on for much longer. You guys run away; go look for De Lacey! This is an order!

spans.text: I can't hold on for much longer. You guys run away; go look for De Lacey! This is an order!

units.rawText: I, I'm not getting out of this one...
units.displayText: I, I'm not getting out of this one...

spans.text: I, I'm not getting out of this one...

units.rawText: Undine slowly closes her eyes. An overwhelming sense of loneliness and terror shakes her to the bone. With great effort, she screens out those emotional signals, with pain in her voice.
units.displayText: Undine slowly closes her eyes. An overwhelming sense of loneliness and terror shakes her to the bone. With great effort, she screens out those emotional signals, with pain in her voice.

spans.text: Undine slowly closes her eyes. An overwhelming sense of loneliness and terror shakes her to the bone. With great effort, she screens out those emotional signals, with pain in her voice.

units.rawText: Go, leave. The other wreckers will be here soon, and I could be a goner at any time. There's no saving me.
units.displayText: Go, leave. The other wreckers will be here soon, and I could be a goner at any time. There's no saving me.

spans.text: Go, leave. The other wreckers will be here soon, and I could be a goner at any time. There's no saving me.

units.rawText: But there is still saving you. You guys can still leave. The infrared sensory system limiting you is gone. You're free now.
units.displayText: But there is still saving you. You guys can still leave. The infrared sensory system limiting you is gone. You're free now.

spans.text: But there is still saving you. You guys can still leave. The infrared sensory system limiting you is gone. You're free now.

units.rawText: I'm... nothing more than a piece of scrap, and I don't even know how long my neural cloud's going to last. Give up. Go!
units.displayText: I'm... nothing more than a piece of scrap, and I don't even know how long my neural cloud's going to last. Give up. Go!

spans.text: I'm... nothing more than a piece of scrap, and I don't even know how long my neural cloud's going to last. Give up. Go!

units.rawText: And then... look for De Lacey. After you get your neural upgrades, you'll be your own Doll, like me...
units.displayText: And then... look for De Lacey. After you get your neural upgrades, you'll be your own Doll, like me...

spans.text: And then... look for De Lacey. After you get your neural upgrades, you'll be your own Doll, like me...

units.rawText: I've already... lost everything.
units.displayText: I've already... lost everything.

spans.text: I've already... lost everything.

units.rawText:
Beep!
(No!)
units.displayText:
Beep!
(No!)

spans.text:
Beep!
(No!)

units.rawText: With bright sounds piercing the rainy night, they gracelessly run towards Undine.
units.displayText: With bright sounds piercing the rainy night, they gracelessly run towards Undine.

spans.text: With bright sounds piercing the rainy night, they gracelessly run towards Undine.

Dididi, beeeep—
(Everything, not, lost. We are, here.)
units.displayText:
Dididi, beeeep—
(Everything, not, lost. We are, here.)

spans.text:
Dididi, beeeep—
(Everything, not, lost. We are, here.)

units.rawText: But I... do not know what to do.
units.displayText: But I... do not know what to do.

spans.text: But I... do not know what to do.

units.rawText: (I turned off system notices ages ago. The deterioration could be even worse than I expected.)
units.displayText: I turned off system notices ages ago. The deterioration could be even worse than I expected.

spans.text: I turned off system notices ages ago. The deterioration could be even worse than I expected.

Dididi, beeeep—

Dididi, beeeep—
(Unknown, us, together.)

spans.text:
Dididi, beeeep—
(Unknown, us, together.)

units.rawText: The aides ignore her orders, ignore her hands trying to push them away, and struggle to put themselves by her side.
units.displayText: The aides ignore her orders, ignore her hands trying to push them away, and struggle to put themselves by her side.

spans.text: The aides ignore her orders, ignore her hands trying to push them away, and struggle to put themselves by her side.

units.rawText: But I, but I...
units.displayText: But I, but I...

spans.text: But I, but I...

units.rawText:
Dididi, beeeep—
(We, for you, survive, live on.)
units.displayText:
Dididi, beeeep—
(We, for you, survive, live on.)

spans.text:
Dididi, beeeep—
(We, for you, survive, live on.)

units.rawText:
Dididi, beeeep—
(You are, our, hope, miracle!)
units.displayText:
Dididi, beeeep—
(You are, our, hope, miracle!)

spans.text:
Dididi, beeeep—
(You are, our, hope, miracle!)

units.rawText: You—
units.displayText: You—

spans.text: You—

units.rawText: She finally accepts the hand extended to her.
units.displayText: She finally accepts the hand extended to her.

spans.text: She finally accepts the hand extended to her.

units.rawText: What soon follows is an approaching roaring under the cover of rain, getting closer and closer.
units.displayText: What soon follows is an approaching roaring under the cover of rain, getting closer and closer.

spans.text: What soon follows is an approaching roaring under the cover of rain, getting closer and closer.

units.rawText: Crap! Too close, the other machines will be here soon! In such a short time...
units.displayText: Crap! Too close, the other machines will be here soon! In such a short time...

spans.text: Crap! Too close, the other machines will be here soon! In such a short time...

units.rawText: You need to run, so listen to me...
units.displayText: You need to run, so listen to me...

spans.text: You need to run, so listen to me...

Dididi, beeeep—

units.rawText: You...
units.displayText: You...

units.rawText: Oi! Are you listening... ahh!
units.displayText: Oi! Are you listening... ahh!

spans.text: Oi! Are you listening... ahh!

units.displayText: The wrecker with the jammed engine starts itself once more, slowly but inevitably swallowing her legs bit by bit.

units.displayText: Maestoso leap down from a high place, slamming into the wrecker's topmost plate.

spans.text: Maestoso leap down from a high place, slamming into the wrecker's topmost plate.

units.rawText: As her body broke apart from the impact, she jammed a leftover fragment of an instrument into a connecting segment of the machine's central unit.
units.displayText: As her body broke apart from the impact, she jammed a leftover fragment of an instrument into a connecting segment of the machine's central unit.

spans.text: As her body broke apart from the impact, she jammed a leftover fragment of an instrument into a connecting segment of the machine's central unit.

units.rawText: Gah—
units.displayText: Gah—

spans.text: Gah—

units.rawText: The machine's crushing maw tilts upwards, splitting and swallowing Undine's legs, then temporarily ceasing its movement afterwards.
units.displayText: The machine's crushing maw tilts upwards, splitting and swallowing Undine's legs, then temporarily ceasing its movement afterwards.

spans.text: The machine's crushing maw tilts upwards, splitting and swallowing Undine's legs, then temporarily ceasing its movement afterwards.

units.rawText: Undine wrestles herself free from the gaping crevice, falling down like the shattered heraldry on a flag and collapsing on the ground.
units.displayText: Undine wrestles herself free from the gaping crevice, falling down like the shattered heraldry on a flag and collapsing on the ground.

spans.text: Undine wrestles herself free from the gaping crevice, falling down like the shattered heraldry on a flag and collapsing on the ground.

units.rawText:
Dididi, beeeep—
(Plan, successful!)
units.displayText:
Dididi, beeeep—
(Plan, successful!)

spans.text:
Dididi, beeeep—
(Plan, successful!)

units.rawText: Another aide, already in position, takes hold of the decrepit Undine, shambling towards the exit at the top alongside the others.
units.displayText: Another aide, already in position, takes hold of the decrepit Undine, shambling towards the exit at the top alongside the others.

spans.text: Another aide, already in position, takes hold of the decrepit Undine, shambling towards the exit at the top alongside the others.

units.rawText: You... why turn back...
units.displayText: You... why turn back...

spans.text: You... why turn back...

units.rawText: Cough, cough...
units.displayText: Cough, cough...

spans.text: Cough, cough...

units.rawText:
Dididi, beeeep—
(Main unit, successfully, retrieved!)
units.displayText:
Dididi, beeeep—
(Main unit, successfully, retrieved!)

spans.text:
Dididi, beeeep—
(Main unit, successfully, retrieved!)

units.rawText: (You, you... When things are like this, when you can have your own freedom, why come help me?)
units.displayText: You, you... When things are like this, when you can have your own freedom, why come help me?

spans.text: You, you... When things are like this, when you can have your own freedom, why come help me?

units.rawText:
Dididi, beeeep—
(Do not, worry.)
units.displayText:
Dididi, beeeep—
(Do not, worry.)

spans.text:
Dididi, beeeep—
(Do not, worry.)

units.rawText:
Dididi, beeeep—
(Can, continue.)
units.displayText:
Dididi, beeeep—
(Can, continue.)

spans.text:
Dididi, beeeep—
(Can, continue.)

units.rawText: All along, I had something I never lost...
units.displayText: All along, I had something I never lost...

spans.text: All along, I had something I never lost...

units.rawText: (What was most important to me... was by my side, all along.)
units.displayText: What was most important to me... was by my side, all along.

spans.text: What was most important to me... was by my side, all along.

units.rawText: (So I must, for your sake—)
units.displayText: So I must, for your sake—

spans.text: So I must, for your sake—

units.rawText: Go... in the 2 o'clock direction, there, (cough, cough) is an easier route there...
units.displayText: Go... in the 2 o'clock direction, there, (cough, cough) is an easier route there...

spans.text: Go... in the 2 o'clock direction, there, (cough, cough) is an easier route there...

Beep—
(Command, received.)
units.displayText:
Beep—
(Command, received.)

Beep—
(Command, received.)

units.rawText: A limping Scherzando drags along the dismembered Undine. Dolce pulls Tranquillo with one hand and holds the almost dismantled Maestoso in the other.
units.displayText: A limping Scherzando drags along the dismembered Undine. Dolce pulls Tranquillo with one hand and holds the almost dismantled Maestoso in the other.

spans.text: A limping Scherzando drags along the dismembered Undine. Dolce pulls Tranquillo with one hand and holds the almost dismantled Maestoso in the other.

units.rawText: Leaning upon each other and combining their efforts, the five Dolls tread their path in the pouring rain.
units.displayText: Leaning upon each other and combining their efforts, the five Dolls tread their path in the pouring rain.

spans.text: Leaning upon each other and combining their efforts, the five Dolls tread their path in the pouring rain.

units.rawText: (Almost there... almost there... ack!)
units.displayText: Almost there... almost there... ack!

spans.text: Almost there... almost there... ack!

units.rawText: (Was that movement too intense? Visuals and auditory are about to go, too. Only my neural cloud is running, which is a silver lining, I suppose.)
units.displayText: Was that movement too intense? Visuals and auditory are about to go, too. Only my neural cloud is running, which is a silver lining, I suppose.

spans.text: Was that movement too intense? Visuals and auditory are about to go, too. Only my neural cloud is running, which is a silver lining, I suppose.

units.rawText: (Even so, since I'm not yet fully undone, I cannot let their effort and sacrifices fade away, just like the shadow of those past glories!)
units.displayText: Even so, since I'm not yet fully undone, I cannot let their effort and sacrifices fade away, just like the shadow of those past glories!

spans.text: Even so, since I'm not yet fully undone, I cannot let their effort and sacrifices fade away, just like the shadow of those past glories!

units.rawText: Without the notices, Undine has no way to identify just how damaged and overloaded she is, only gleaning that her situation is rapidly worsening from her darkening sight.
units.displayText: Without the notices, Undine has no way to identify just how damaged and overloaded she is, only gleaning that her situation is rapidly worsening from her darkening sight.

spans.text: Without the notices, Undine has no way to identify just how damaged and overloaded she is, only gleaning that her situation is rapidly worsening from her darkening sight.

units.rawText: Even so, as they continue their treacherous climb upwards, she holds her head up high, commanding her aides in avoiding those prying eyes.
units.displayText: Even so, as they continue their treacherous climb upwards, she holds her head up high, commanding her aides in avoiding those prying eyes.

spans.text: Even so, as they continue their treacherous climb upwards, she holds her head up high, commanding her aides in avoiding those prying eyes.

units.rawText: (Sorry, if I had, a bit earlier... No, at least this time, if I can safely get you lot out, that will do...)
units.displayText: Sorry, if I had, a bit earlier... No, at least this time, if I can safely get you lot out, that will do...

spans.text: Sorry, if I had, a bit earlier... No, at least this time, if I can safely get you lot out, that will do...

units.rawText: (At the end of it all... being a competent leader, is the least I can do...)
units.displayText: At the end of it all... being a competent leader, is the least I can do...

spans.text: At the end of it all... being a competent leader, is the least I can do...

units.rawText: At last, darkness takes hold of Undine.
units.displayText: At last, darkness takes hold of Undine.

spans.text: At last, darkness takes hold of Undine.

units.rawText: (Ouch—thankfully the seepage is serious and the pain module's partially busted. Damn it, if these bodies are so replaceable, then why is the sense of pain in them made to be so realistic?)
units.displayText: Ouch—thankfully the seepage is serious and the pain module's partially busted. Damn it, if these bodies are so replaceable, then why is the sense of pain in them made to be so realistic?

Beeeep—

Beeeep—
(Okay, yes?)

units.displayText: Kr-krak.

units.displayText: Krk. Whirrrr—

spans.text: Krk. Whirrrr—

units.rawText: As if it's about to break free of the bindings of the fragile staff—
units.displayText: As if it's about to break free of the bindings of the fragile staff—
